RobustnessStatement: 300 SPICE simulations were performed using the specified tolerance perturbations.
All tested tolerance-perturbed simulations remained physically valid (100.0%).
Low-case gain standard deviation was 0.6883 dB with CV 3.019%.
Medium-case gain standard deviation was 0.4848 dB with CV 1.234%.
High-case gain standard deviation was 0.7663 dB with CV 1.630%.
The robustness result demonstrates stability within the tested tolerance ranges; it should not be generalized beyond those specified perturbation ranges.
